name: cmr-assistant
description: Discover and relevance-rank NASA Earthdata (CMR) collections for an Earth science question: normalize terms to GCMD keywords, search collections, verify granule availability, and return Concept IDs with transparent, reproducible provenance. Read-only and human-in-the-loop — never recommends, endorses, or downloads.

cmr_mcp_url.title: CMR MCP server URL
cmr_mcp_url.description: HTTP endpoint of the CMR Data Server to use (e.g. https://w4hu71445m.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/mcp/cmr/mcp/). Provided at install rather than hard-coded, so you can point the plugin at your own deployment. The server is public — no token needed.
